say:1:1131041001:1.text: As you know, many adults from nearby tribes were lured by the Adamant Syndicate to dig for treasure. A lot of kids lost their parents and other kin.
say:1:1131041001:1.source_cn: 唉，你知道的，附近部族很多青壮年都被黑金骗去挖宝了，许...
say:1:1131041001:1.male: As you know, many adults from nearby tribes were lured by the Adamant Syndicate to dig for treasure. A lot of kids lost their parents and other kin.
say:1:1131041001:1.female: As you know, many adults from nearby tribes were lured by the Adamant Syndicate to dig for treasure. A lot of kids lost their parents and other kin.

say:2:1131041002:1.text: Look how few of them managed to come home! Not to mention how many of the survivors are still badly injured.
say:2:1131041002:1.source_cn: 可是现在呢？才回来了多少人？更别提这里有多少伤员了。
say:2:1131041002:1.male: Look how few of them managed to come home! Not to mention how many of the survivors are still badly injured.
say:2:1131041002:1.female: Look how few of them managed to come home! Not to mention how many of the survivors are still badly injured.

say:3:1131041003:1.text: Honestly, they're lucky to be alive. The rest will never be seen by their families again...
say:3:1131041003:1.source_cn: 实话实说，能活着回来已经算好的了。还有很多人，再也见不...
say:3:1131041003:1.male: Honestly, they're lucky to be alive. The rest will never be seen by their families again...
say:3:1131041003:1.female: Honestly, they're lucky to be alive. The rest will never be seen by their families again...

say:4:1131041004:1.text: I don't have the heart to break this news to the children. I don't want to see their tears, so I came here to be alone...
say:4:1131041004:1.source_cn: 我不忍心把这些消息告诉孩子们，也不想看到他们哭，只能跑...
say:4:1131041004:1.male: I don't have the heart to break this news to the children. I don't want to see their tears, so I came here to be alone...
say:4:1131041004:1.female: I don't have the heart to break this news to the children. I don't want to see their tears, so I came here to be alone...

choice_prompt:5:1131041004.source_cn: 我不忍心把这些消息告诉孩子们，也不想看到他们哭，只能跑到这里……
choice_prompt:5:1131041004.male: I don't have the heart to break this news to the children. I don't want to see their tears, so I came here to be alone...
choice_prompt:5:1131041004.female: I don't have the heart to break this news to the children. I don't want to see their tears, so I came here to be alone...

say:7:1131041006:1.text: But it's no time to cry. I can't show any weakness to the younglings.
say:7:1131041006:1.source_cn: 但我不能哭。否则，那些孩子一定会看出我内心的软弱。
say:7:1131041006:1.male: But it's no time to cry. I can't show any weakness to the younglings.
say:7:1131041006:1.female: But it's no time to cry. I can't show any weakness to the younglings.

say:8:1131041007:1.text: With so much pain inside, they are the ones who need to cry out...
say:8:1131041007:1.source_cn: 他们比我更需要哭泣，更需要释放痛苦……
say:8:1131041007:1.male: With so much pain inside, they are the ones who need to cry out...
say:8:1131041007:1.female: With so much pain inside, they are the ones who need to cry out...
